answer_1.quote: DSI paradigm involves two tasks: (i) memorization task where the goal is to learn an indexer f θ : X → Y, a text-to-text model parameterized by θ ∈ R P , that takes document tokens (x ∈ X ) as input and maps it to a document identifier (docid) j ∈ Y, and (ii) retrieval task where the goal is to use the same indexer f θ to directly map a user query q to a relevant docid j ∈ Y.
answer_1.outputs: Document identifiers (docids) generated from input text (documents or queries)

answer_2.quote: For DSI evaluation, we report indexing accuracy for memorization task and Hits@k (k ∈ {1, 10}) metric for retrieval task.
